title: 5 Million Lego Pieces Fell In The Sea. They Never Stopped Washing Up 🧱
caption:
Nearly five million Lego pieces fell into the sea 🧱
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1997 a huge wave hit the cargo ship Tokio Express off Cornwall and 62 containers fell overboard. One held nearly five million Lego pieces, and beachcombers are still finding them.
Would you go beach hunting for Lego? 👇
first_comment: Somewhere on a beach right now a single Lego octopus is waiting for you. Would you hunt for it? 🐙👇
